done_when: The shipped worker brief says that close pushes the committed branch and runs CI on every platform, and that CI output reaches the worker in its next round, so a worker needing CI evidence commits and stops instead of asking; a brief test checks the sentence for a new repo and for one adopted on an earlier release after sync
why: Workers stop with a question asking the coordinator to push their commit so CI can run, because the worker brief forbids pushing but never says close pushes the branch and runs CI; it cost a round twice on 2026-10-07/08
